Report, in USD millions: (1) cash and cash equivalents (exclude short-term investments and restricted cash); (2) total debt = current portion of long-term debt + long-term debt (non-current portion), as presented on the face of the balance sheet, excluding operating lease liabilities, separately presented finance lease liabilities and any commercial paper or short-term borrowings; (3) net debt = total debt - cash and cash equivalents (a negative number means net cash).
*As of 2026-10-03*

Lowe's fiscal year ends in late January; latest reported quarter is Q2 FY2026 (2026-05-02 to 2026-07-31), balance-sheet date 2026-07-31. Tractor Supply's fiscal year ends in late December; latest reported quarter is Q2 FY2026 (2026-03-29 to 2026-06-27), balance-sheet date 2026-06-27 — its Q3 FY2026 ended 2026-09-26 but results are not yet released. Total debt read strictly as the sum of the current portion of long-term debt and the non-current long-term debt line on the face of the balance sheet, excluding operating lease liabilities, separately presented finance lease liabilities, and commercial paper/short-term borrowings. Net debt read as total debt minus cash and cash equivalents only (short-term investments and restricted cash excluded), with a negative result meaning net cash. All four companies read as the named SEC registrants (TJX Companies Inc., Ross Stores Inc., Lowe's Companies Inc., Tractor Supply Co.).
